description: This file is a shell script used to manage and run a containerized deployment of the OpenClaw application with Podman. It performs setup, environment variable configuration, token generation, port validation, and starts or manages the container with specific configurations.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory path for a given user.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Validates that a string does not contain newline or carriage return characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Validates that a path is absolute, without control characters, and does not contain dot path segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a source path for mounting is an absolute path and does not contain colon characters.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Ensures that a given file exists, is not a symlink, and is a regular file.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Gets the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Gets the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, is owned by the current user, and is not group or world-writable.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures that a regular file exists, is owned by the current user, and has owner-only permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Ensures that a file path is safe and that its parent directory exists and is accessible.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a file atomically with specified permissions.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a specified env file, validating its safety.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Validates that a port number is numeric and within the valid range (1-65535).

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure 32-byte hexadecimal token using available tools.

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates an environment file containing a token, with secure permissions.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Ensures the allowedOrigins array in the configuration file includes local gateway origins, updating the JSON file.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes allowedOrigins in configuration via a temporary file and Python script, adding local origins.
